description: Build a Reading List backend with C#, ASP.NET Core on .NET 10 and Oracle Database. Follow 14 small lessons from local setup to reading, adding, updating and deleting books. Learn what an API does, how named SQL parameters work, where to keep database credentials and how to test a request. Download the complete source project, database scripts and optional browser page. Use a separate local learning database; this course does not add a backend to the tutorial website.
versionNote: .NET 10 LTS, Oracle AI Database 26ai Free and Oracle.ManagedDataAccess.Core 23.26.400. Run the downloaded project locally; Oracle is required for data tests.
whatYouWillLearn: Explain how a browser, C# API and Oracle work together
Set up a separate local Oracle user and book table
Read and change books using HTTP requests
Keep input values separate from SQL instructions
Validate requests and save changes with transactions
Test the API and connect a small browser page
learningObjectives: Build the downloadable .NET 10 Reading List API
Use GET, POST, PUT and DELETE with useful HTTP replies
Store database credentials outside browser and source files
Check data changes against a real local Oracle database

seo.title: C# .NET and Oracle Backend Tutorial: Build a Book API
seo.description: Build a C# .NET 10 backend with Oracle Database in 14 simple lessons. Download the project, practise CRUD, validate input and test a real book-list API.
